partitions.local_reduction: ordered binary K tree within each output row region
partitions.cross_region: ordered chunked output gather along M axis

output_consumer.kind: qualification sink; future lowering must bind a real adjacent consumer

cost.scope: Static per-epoch directed-link traffic and input/native/gather causal-path hop accounting. Includes one teardown word per input stream. Does not model contention timing, callback cost, queue occupancy or predict tokens/s.

buffers.name: packet
buffers.release: producer send completion / worker native completion

buffers.name: child-left/right
buffers.release: both callbacks and joined sum consumed

buffers.name: decoded/sum
buffers.release: native complete before ordered join; outgoing send complete before reuse

protocol: All receivers arm before kick. Kick arrival starts independent K input producers. Worker input arrival executes native arithmetic; two child callbacks gate ordered local-left-right join. Root sends bounded chunks; send completion credits the next gather receive. Input teardown and local finish gate the next epoch.
